title: Global bounded BINDS evidence audit benchmark

protocol.population: Every graph disease and its first ten supported candidates under the audit baseline scorer
protocol.selection: No sampling or manual disease/candidate selection; IDs and score ties deterministic
protocol.model: Same saved model and scaler, no fitting; legacy scorer remains unchanged
protocol.failure_scope: Any recorded BINDS edge anywhere in the graph; total edge deletions bounded by budget
protocol.greedy: Every available next global edge evaluated; maximize current supported rank, unsupported preferred; lexicographic edge-ID ties; retain best prefix
protocol.strong_greedy: Same exhaustive next-edge search, maximizing current rank after preferring unsupported; ties minimize focus score minus kth highest supported rival score, then focus score, then edge-ID. The rival threshold is recomputed after each edit. No kth rival means an infinite positive margin.
protocol.verification: All certificates receive same-algorithm optimality recheck and independent full-matrix witness replay; all greedy witnesses also replayed
protocol.maximality_oracle: Independent literal-path exhaustive global-subset enumeration in tests/test_binding_audit.py, not full real-graph global enumeration
protocol.examples: Largest observed competitor/greedy gap; first ID-ordered query wins ties; all results retained
protocol.clinical_interpretation: Model fragility and algorithm correctness only; not clinical efficacy or experimental success

numerical_comparison.interpretation: Audit scores use explicit fixed-order binary64 arithmetic. Legacy scores use BLAS; small last-bit differences are disclosed, not hidden with display rounding.

certificate.interpretation: This is an exact finite-budget audit of this fixed model under withdrawal of any recorded BINDS edges, including edges of competing compounds. It is not a biological intervention or a probability of efficacy. Source labels are not independent studies. The audit uses its declared fixed-order float64 scorer and score/compound-ID ties; legacy BLAS scores can differ in the last floating-point bits. Exactness is relative to this binary64 numerical runtime; transcendental functions can differ across runtimes, and verification rejects numerical mismatches. A null worst supported rank means no supported scenario exists. Unsupported outcomes are reported separately. The guarantee does not cover other edge families, correlated source-group failures, new edges, model refitting, or deletion budgets above the requested limit.
